# KaTeX

[![Build Status](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/workflows/Node.js%20CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/actions)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/katex.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex)

KaTeX is a fast, easy-to-use JavaScript library for TeX math rendering on the web.

## Notation and Formulas

Here is an inline formula: $E = mc^2$ and $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$.

Inline HTML formatting for superscripts and subscripts:
- Dimension X<sup>(k+1)</sup> is computed from X<sup>(k)</sup>.
- Index element A<sub>i,j</sub> in matrix representation.

Display Math equation:

$$
\frac{1}{\Bigl(\sqrt{\phi \sqrt{5}}-\phi\Bigr) e^{\frac25 \pi}} = 1+\frac{e^{-2\pi}} {1+\frac{e^{-4\pi}} {1+\frac{e^{-6\pi}} {1+\frac{e^{-8\pi}} {1+\cdots} } } }
$$

## Browser Support

All modern browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.
